documents.title: Noting In The Board Meeting Dated 29.10.2026 Delay In Submission Of Shareholding Pattern Under Reg 31(1)(B) To NSE.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Menon Bearings reported strong financial results for Q2 and H1 FY27, with management expressing confidence in achieving over 30% growth for the full year FY27 and maintaining robust performance driven by domestic markets, exports to the US, and emerging business in Europe. The company is actively investing in automation, robotics, and AI inspection systems to reduce manpower dependency, improve productivity, and absorb rising raw material and input costs. Management highlighted that new product developments in the Alkop and bearing segments, along with a diversified application portfolio, continue to support sustainable operating margins and strong customer demand. Menon Bearings Limited reported its financial and operational performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, highlighting strong growth in consolidated revenue, EBITDA, and net profit. Management detailed ongoing capacity expansions, automation roadmaps, and strategic energy-saving initiatives across divisions.

guidance.claim: Management expects more than 30% growth for FY27.
guidance.quote: There will be more than 30% growth for this year, FY27, and similarly in '27-'28 also we expect, if all the things are in place, it will be more than 30% again, with the growth drivers are basically domestic and whatever export that USA exports are growing rapidly.

guidance.claim: For FY27-28, management expects estimated additional business of INR 131 crores.
guidance.quote: And for '27-'28, we expect that estimated additional business will be of INR 131 crores, so that, the growth rate will be obviously more than 30%, with '28-'29, the growth driver, we are having the list of all customers also from whom we are estimated to get the business, RFQs are there, and discussions are going on, commercials have been finalized.

guidance.claim: Management targets EBITDA margins of about 23% for next year.
guidance.quote: And what we are targeting for next year, the EBITDA margins will be about 23%.

guidance.claim: Management expects to potentially reach INR 500 crore turnover next year or the year after.
guidance.quote: So we are taking a lot of efforts so we can reach INR500 crore next year. Most likely next year or maybe year after that.

guidance.claim: For 2029, the company expects additional business of INR 157 crores excluding potential Europe business.
guidance.quote: And with this, for 2029, we expect additional business of INR 157 crores, excluding potential business of INR 35 crores of Europe that we estimate it will take little more time, but 100% we are going to convert that.

guidance.claim: The management stated that the total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores.
guidance.quote: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores, subject to good monsoon and geopolitical situation doesn't worsen further.

guidance.claim: For the Alkop division, the management is targeting INR100 crores for this year and around INR125 crores for next year.
guidance.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

guidance.claim: The management expects the export share of total revenue to go up to 37% by next year.
guidance.quote: As we expect that by next year, the export may go up to 37% after total revenue.

guidance.claim: The management reiterated a conservative full-year revenue figure of INR360 crores.
guidance.quote: So, INR360 crores, I would say is a conservative figure and we will stick to that.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that recent European tours are yielding business potential of more than INR 35 crores to be converted into actual sales in FY27-28 and FY28-29.
demand_outlook.quote: Along with that, our recently Europe tour is yielding a significant increase in the business and potential of more than INR 35 crores that will be converted into the actual sale in the year '27-'28 and '28-'29.

demand_outlook.claim: For FY26-27, additional expected business on a consolidated basis is around INR 30 crores based on current business pipelines and commercial discussions.
demand_outlook.quote: And what I feel, that considering the current business pipeline and the commercial discussions and RFQs that we have received, for '26-'27, additional business expected is around INR 30 crores on consolidated basis.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that EV share from the Alkop segment is in line with the guidance of 8% to 10% for FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Just wanted to understand, are we in line with the guidance of 8% to 10% of EV share from the Alkop segment for FY27?

demand_outlook.claim: The underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: While the global business environment continues to present certain uncertainties, the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the recent visit to Canada and USA is expected to yield substantial volumes in the coming period of the year.
demand_outlook.quote: That is because, more particularly, due to our last month's visit to Canada and USA, is expected to yield substantial volumes in the coming period of the year.

capex_expansion.claim: The planned investment for Menon Alkop over the next 12 to 15 months is roughly INR 5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So what figures we have told you, what we are going to achieve. So this is the investment we are doing to increase productivity and to get these numbers. So this is the investment we are getting, and roughly ROI will be in the next 2.5, 3 years, should be the return on investment on this investment what we are doing. Thank you.

capex_expansion.claim: The planned investment for Menon Bearings over the next 12 to 15 months is roughly INR 4 crores to INR 4.5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: And I will not say only for automation and R&D how much we are investing, but next two years in Menon Bearings and Alkop, 12 months, around INR5 crores in Menon Alkop and around INR4.5 crores in Menon Bearings.

capex_expansion.claim: An additional ₹2.50 crore capex is planned over next 2 years for the brake capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: ₹0.58 crore fully deployed in FY26 with ₹2.50 crore additional planned over next 2 years

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing about INR9 crores to INR10 crores this financial year for increasing bi-metal capacity by 25% to 30%.
capex_expansion.quote: you will come to know that we are investing about INR9 crores to INR10 crores of rupees for this year, this financial year for increasing the capacity and which is expected to increase the capacity by almost 25% to 30%, which may yield the total revenue of more than INR25 crores, which can generate revenue of INR25 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The dynamometer for the brake segment is under construction and expected by the end of August.
capex_expansion.quote: You see, basically that is under construction now and is expected by the end of August.

capex_expansion.claim: Alkop has a CapEx of around INR4 crores for the current year.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are having the CapEx of around INR4 crores of for this year in Alkop alone.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that raw material prices for aluminium, copper, tin, lead, and steel have increased, but process improvements helped sustain margins.
margins_costs.quote: In spite of volatility in the raw material prices, and basically in copper, tin, lead and steel, the prices have gone up substantially. In spite of that whatever the exercises that we have made, improvement in the processes, so we have reduced substantially so far as the consumption of all these raw material and input material is concerned.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that the company has a pre-decided formula and mechanism to pass on raw material price increases to customers.
margins_costs.quote: You see, as I already told you that whatever raw material prices, those are volatile, but we are always having a pre-decided formula. So far as increasing the raw material is concerned, we can pass on that burden to the customers or if the prices are reduced, then those prices will get reduced.

margins_costs.claim: Operating expenses for Q2 FY27 stood at ₹65.28 Crores.
EBITDA in the brakes segment has reached 25%.
margins_costs.quote: But at the same time, I would like to tell you that right from 12% EBITDA earlier, now we have reached to 25% EBITDA in brakes also.

margins_costs.claim: Carbide tool prices for all automobile manufacturers have increased by 300%.
margins_costs.quote: Consumables, for example, carbide tools for all manufacturers, all automobile carbide tools are required.Those carbide tools price are increased by 300%.

margins_costs.claim: Bi-metal EBITDA margins are around 21% plus, Alkop is almost 21%, and brakes achieved 25% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: So, for the bi-metal is concerned the margin, so, EBITDA margins are around 21% plus. Then Alkop, it is almost 21%. And now, for this quarter, in brakes, we have achieved 25%.

orders_capacity.claim: Management highlighted that around 54 parts have been developed for Menon Alkop over the last two years where start of business has begun.
orders_capacity.quote: For Menon Alkop, we have developed around 54 parts in the last two years, and they all SOB has begun.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has a robust network of 1,000 dealers and distributors.
orders_capacity.quote: Robust network of 1,000 dealers and distributors

orders_capacity.claim: Company products are present at 10,000+ retail outlets across India.
orders_capacity.quote: Products present at 10,000+ retail outlets across India

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at Menon Bearings is at 87% for bi-metal.
orders_capacity.quote: looking at the 87%, actually, which is the capacity utilization at Menon Bearing.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that all CapEx is currently being funded out of internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: Whatever CapEx that we are doing, that is out of internal accruals, which are definitely having the impact on the cash accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: CapEx for bi-metal and Alkop will be funded through internal accruals only with no fresh loan taken.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, so far as whatever we are considering so far as bi-metal and Alkop is concerned, it will be through internal accruals only, no fresh loan will be taken.

risks_headwinds.claim: Merchant export orders were stuck over the prior three months due to the backlog caused by the Strait of Hormuz and war.
risks_headwinds.quote: last three months, those merchant export orders were stuck because of backlog because of the Straight of Hormuz and the war.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to introduce automation and visual AI systems in the next 9 to 12 months.
management_commitments.quote: So in the next 9 to 12 months, a lot of automation and visual systems are getting in place where we save on manpower, we save on time that leads in productivity, and quality is more focused.

management_commitments.claim: Five robotic automation initiatives are rolling out from November 2026 to April 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Five initiatives rolling out Nov 2026 – Apr 2027 to lift productivity, quality and machine utilization

management_commitments.claim: Installation of the dual-CNC robotic cell (AMS) for Honeywell STT caps is underway in November 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Dual-CNC robotic cell (AMS) Honeywell STT caps Installation underway Nov 2026

management_commitments.claim: Execution of the dual-VMC robotic cell (Brother) for JD ISG parts is targeted for January 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Dual-VMC robotic cell (Brother) JD ISG parts Design complete; execution in progress Jan 2027

management_commitments.claim: Simulation and design for the dual-VMC robotic cell (AMS) for Honeywell STT housings is underway for March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Dual-VMC robotic cell (AMS) Honeywell STT housings Simulation and design underway Mar 2027

management_commitments.claim: Design exploration with suppliers for vision inspection and powder coating automation is set for April 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Vision inspection and powder coating automation JD ISG parts, Honeywell caps Design exploration with supplier Apr 2027

management_commitments.claim: In the railway brake segment, the business is expected to start at around INR5 crores to INR6 crores in the first year and eventually go up to INR25 crores to INR30 crores.
management_commitments.quote: we expect that to start with, we will have a business of around INR5 crores to INR6 crores to start with and eventually it will go up to INR25 crores to INR30 crores within next two years.

management_commitments.claim: The dynamometer is expected to be commissioned by the end of August.
management_commitments.quote: You see, basically that is under construction now and is expected by the end of August.

management_commitments.claim: The technical team testing rig for brakes should be all running by September end.
management_commitments.quote: So by September end, it should be all running.

management_commitments.claim: The share of EV in the Alkop business can be in the range of 8% to 10% by the end of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: in the Alkop business, the share of EV by FY27 end can be in the range of 8% to 10%.

management_commitments.claim: Target for the Alkop division is INR100 crores for this year and around INR125 crores next year.
management_commitments.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
